outcome: Two more runs. The third review attempt, with --allow read --permission-mode dontAsk, was cancelled after two turns ($0.0236): dontAsk denies rather than allows. A one-line probe with --permission-mode bypassPermissions then read package.json and answered correctly ($0.0165), which established that reading works and named the flag.
note: SuperGrok Lite is a fixed monthly fee, so this is WEIGHT, not a bill. Three cancelled reviews cost $0.125 of weight and produced no verdict; the $0.0165 probe produced the answer. Probe before spending a review.

totals.why: Grok runs on the owner's SuperGrok Lite subscription, a fixed monthly fee, so this call cannot be priced as spending: one more run does not raise the invoice. The total_cost_usd it reports is what the call WOULD have cost at API prices, and is recorded as weight.
